Subject: Wednesday 5th March 12 noon  - Study Centre Auditorium

This message is sent on behalf of the College of Business Student Group.

Throughout the year this student group organises events to foster
networking opportunities for students with businesses and academics.
This invitation is for you, as an Auckland Massey University staff
member, to the first event of the year.  Keep a look out for the next
event which is going to be a strategy competition in April.

Helen Robinson
Talking on the topic INNOVATION
Study Centre Auditorium
12 noon
 
Helen Robinson is currently Head of Auckland's Metro Project. She has
led a number of successful businesses during her career, including her
own company and was well known as Managing Director of Microsoft New
Zealand. Previous to this Helen was Vice President for Australia and New
Zealand at Pivotal  Corporation a customer relationship management firm.
 
A theme of Helen's career has been her strong passion and drive to
deliver value to stakeholders through technology, this supports the
theme of our event.
 
Helen's interests lie  in innovation and export strategies, she serves
on several  boards including New Zealand Business Excellence Foundation
and Auckland Plus.
 
We look forward to hearing what she has to say!
